title: See Banner Connect in action
intro: Short, clickable walkthroughs of a real school account. Each one follows a family through Banner Christian School and takes about a minute.

demos.title: Capture an inquiry
demos.summary: A parent fills out your website form. Watch what happens next.

demos.title: The nurture sequence
demos.summary: Ten days of thoughtful emails to every new family, without anyone hitting send.

demos.title: Tour scheduling
demos.summary: A parent books a visit online, gets reminders, and a no-show gets a reschedule email.

demos.title: The admissions pipeline
demos.summary: Every family from first inquiry to enrolled, on one screen.

demos.title: Win back quiet families
demos.summary: Families who stopped responding get a short, personal check-in series.

demos.title: Reporting
demos.summary: Your enrollment funnel and tuition in the pipeline, always up to date.

demos.title: Calendar view
demos.summary: Every visit and tour your families booked, on one calendar.

demos.title: One inbox
demos.summary: Reply to emails, texts and Facebook messages from one screen.

demos.title: Open house registration
demos.summary: Registration page, confirmations, reminders and an attendee list.

demos.title: Family newsletter
demos.summary: Send a broadcast email to current families.

demos.title: Video testimonials
demos.summary: Collect short videos from happy parents and show them on your website.

demos.title: Social media planner
demos.summary: Schedule a week of posts across your channels in one sitting.
